== FromStruct -> config.jsonc
{
  "$schema": "./config.schema.json",

  // Log verbosity.
  // One of: debug, info, warn, error.
  "logLevel": "info",

  // Listen address.
  // Required, must not be empty.
  "addr": ":8080",

  // Request timeout.
  // Duration in nanoseconds.
  "timeout": 5000000000, // 5s
  "hosts": [
    "a.example",
    "b.example"
  ],

  // Required. Secret: do not commit a real value.
  "password": "",

  // Primary database.
  "db": {
    "host": "localhost",
    "port": 5432
  }
}
== decoded
